facts.fact: Alex 宣言：April 进入保护性羁押，带去警长站——阻拦者以妨碍司法逮捕。
facts.anchor: I’m placing April Gallagher into protective custody

facts.fact: 她不指控 Scott 袭警——但警告这不是再犯的邀请。
facts.anchor: I’m not going to charge you with assaulting a police officer. But do not take that as an invitation to try it again.

facts.fact: Claire Harper 问去警局要不要请律师——Alex 冷答「我不知道，你知道吗？」
April 走向门口像被押上刑场；丈夫耳语一番后她点了头。
facts.anchor: as though she were being marched off to the gallows.

facts.fact: Alex 拒绝让 Lacey 送人——真实意图：单独在车里也许能问出东西。
facts.anchor: So that she could get April Gallagher alone in a car

facts.fact: Connell 案复盘：伪装外卖司机的杀手踩点、假送单、推门而入；Alex 凌晨 6 点干到现在。
facts.anchor: A killer had been posing as a food delivery driver, stalking his victims

facts.fact: GPS 显示警局 20 分钟车程——Alex 故意低于限速十英里拉长车程。
facts.anchor: ten under the speed limit to elongate the trip as much as possible

facts.fact: 动机排除：无裸露无暴力痕迹不像性侵——Rebecca 不是因「想占有」被选中。
facts.anchor: No, Rebecca Cook hadn’t been selected because the killer had wanted to possess her

facts.fact: 提到 Scott 时 April 突然僵硬——疑点标记。
facts.anchor: April stiffened suddenly at the mention of him.

facts.fact: April 反击：半夜把孩子妈从家里拖走是保护？你是警察——应该你帮我。
facts.anchor: tearing me out of my home and away from my kids in the middle of the fucking night is protecting me
